1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein said first component is a humeral surface component having a non-uniform geometry that differs from the natural anatomy of a humeral head.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature that are independently selected.

9. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is spherically or elliptically shaped with a specific geometric configuration.

13. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a smooth articulating surface with a predetermined surface finish.

20. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has a selectable length from a plurality of discrete stem lengths, wherein each stem length is configured to extend from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper and a screw, wherein the connection is configured to allow selective disconnection and reconnection.

27. (Currently Amended) A glenohumeral joint implant adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint, comprising an implant configured to provide a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus.

28. (Currently Amended) The glenohumeral joint implant of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant.

29. (Currently Amended) A humerus bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem, wherein said stem is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of a humerus bone.
